name: Ashfield Hollow
detailed_description:
It’s been ten years since the outbreak, and the world has gone quiet. Most didn’t make it. You were found unconscious in the city and brought to Camp Ashfield, one of the last settlements still standing. With no memory of who you were, all you can do now is survive and decide who you want to become.

Ashfield Hollow is a 2D post-apocalyptic RPG that blends life sim mechanics like farming, crafting, scavenging, and fishing with real-time combat and survival systems. Build your home, connect with other survivors, and carve out a future in a world that nearly ended—and still can.

⚙️ Features

Survive the Infected and the Desperate
Face relentless infected hordes in real-time combat as you clear dangerous ruins and hold your ground beyond the safety of camp. Future encounters will grow more dangerous as hostile human enemies enter the fray, battling you for the same scarce resources.

Scavenge, Craft, and Improvise
Search through collapsed neighborhoods, locked storefronts, and crumbling infrastructure. Salvage what you can to craft tools, weapons, and furniture, uncovering new recipes in the process. In high-stakes situations, you’ll need to gear up for an endgame extraction mode, where survival depends on what you can gather—and how fast you can get out.

Farm, Fish, and Forage
Grow your own food, gather wild resources, and fish in oceans and lakes. Build water purifiers, manage your supplies, and sustain your camp through harsh conditions. Raise animals like chickens and goats, maintain pens, and collect meat and eggs to support long-term survival.

Customize Your Home
Decorate, expand, and upgrade your personal space with furniture and workstations. Power your home with solar panels or generators. Whether it’s a tiny shack or a self-sustaining base, you decide how to live.

Build Relationships
Spend time with a cast of survivors, help them through personal missions, and unlock heart events as trust grows. Some friendships may even blossom into romance. With time, you’ll be able to commit to a partner, live together, and face the future side by side.

Take on Meaningful Quests
Help maintain and improve the camp through quests that focus on real needs: gathering resources, supporting others, and keeping the operation running in a world that won’t wait. You'll also be able to rescue and recruit new survivors from the wild, expanding your community—if they’re willing to follow you.

Master Deep Skill Trees
Progress through multiple skill paths, including combat, crafting, farming, foraging, mechanics, and medicine. Every action earns experience, unlocking new abilities and crafting options over time. In future updates, bring companions with you—trusted survivors who can support you on high-risk missions.

Discover and Restore the Past
Find the old world’s remains scattered across the ruins—strange relics, forgotten objects, and lost stories. Donate them to the camp’s museum to unlock rewards and piece together fragments of a time long gone.

Explore a Broken World
Travel on foot or by bike through forest outskirts, flooded hospitals, ruined highways, and forgotten subway lines. Push into the unknown and see what still lingers.

short_description: Ten years after the outbreak, you’re found unconscious and taken in by a camp of survivors. Learn to fight, scavenge, farm, and craft as you rebuild your life, form bonds, and maybe even find love in this post-apocalyptic life sim RPG.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620 / Nvidia GT 1030 / Radeon R7 240 or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
